name: underworld-writer
description: Three-use-case skill for fictional underworld narratives, fact-sourced true crime writing, and episodic podcast production with a scripting engine, character development, PACER-informed editorial verification, and an optional self-generated audio/mastering pipeline

cli.description: Command-line tool for character creation and narrative development

podcast_scripting.description: Generate production-ready podcast episode scripts for true crime producers

pacer_integration.description: True crime fact-checking via PACER federal court records

asset_validation.description: Cleanroom sandbox asset validation for distribution compliance

editorial_linting.description: Configurable editorial language linter (banned/discouraged/preferred terms, repetition detection) driven by a per-project style dictionary

podcast_production_audio.description: Deterministic post-production mixer: semantic cue markers, narration ducking, fades, music beds, stingers, two-pass loudness-normalized mastering, and a fail-closed music/SFX rights-clearance registry
podcast_production_audio.requires: Modal account (optional — only for audio synthesis/mastering, not narrative/editorial features)

self_generated_audio.description: Optional $0 open-weight music/SFX generation (ACE-Step 1.5, Stable Audio Open) as an alternative to licensing stock audio, with reproducible prompt/seed manifests and human-approval gating before use

release_publishing.description: Local, scoped-token npm publish pipeline with changelog-driven release evidence and artwork generation
release_publishing.requires: npm account with publish rights (maintainers only)

tools.name: underworld_create_character
tools.description: Create a detailed underworld character profile with three-phase methodology

tools.name: underworld_validate_character
tools.description: Validate a character profile for completeness and consistency

tools.name: underworld_export_character
tools.description: Export character profile as formatted markdown documentation

tools.name: underworld_validate_relationships
tools.description: Check relationship consistency between two characters

tools.name: underworld_generate_episode_script
tools.description: Generate a podcast episode script from underworld character profile with optional PACER case data

tools.name: underworld_create_guest_handoff
tools.description: Create producer brief and guest interview preparation materials for podcast episodes

tools.name: underworld_identify_qa_windows
tools.description: Identify Q&A insertion points in podcast scripts for guest expertise and discussion

tools.name: underworld_flag_missing_facts
tools.description: Flag claims lacking Tier 1 verification for guest interview follow-up opportunities

modal_token_id.title: Modal token ID
modal_token_id.description: Optional — only needed for episode audio synthesis/mastering and the self-generated music/SFX pipeline (see docs/ops/MODAL_SETUP.md). Get one at modal.com/settings/tokens. Not required for character/narrative/editorial features.

modal_token_secret.title: Modal token secret
modal_token_secret.description: Paired with modal_token_id, from the same modal.com/settings/tokens page.

uw_npm_token.title: npm publish token (maintainers only)
uw_npm_token.description: Scoped npm automation token with publish rights to @h4shed/skill-underworld-writer, used by `npm run publish:npm` (docs/ops/PUBLISHING.md). Irrelevant unless you're cutting a release.
